Auramancy Crushing Grasp (Rank 2) Abyssal Charges 3 Range: 0-12 m Magic Attack +110% Instant 24sec Cooldown Creates a powerful gravity vortex around a chosen target after a short delay. Deals (259 + 110% Magic Attack) Magic damage to all enemies in a 15m radius, pulling them to the target's location, but leaves the initial target unharmed. Pulled enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills. Auramancy Rising Hatred (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 2 ~ 4 Range: Caster only Instant 2min Cooldown Effect Granted Fury Increases max Abyssal Charge +2. Adds 2 Abyssal Charges when a skill that increases charges is used. Charges do not decrease naturally. Duration: 6sec Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration. Auramancy Abyssal Wave (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 4 ~ 6 Range: Caster only Magic Attack +180% Cast Time 1sec 14sec Cooldown Shoots a wave of force up to 20m in front of you. Inflicts (778 + 180% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and knocks back all enemies it touches. Pushed enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the number of waves. Being struck by multiple waves in a row dramatically decreases enemies' Move Speed. This skill counts as a Push effect. Passive Passive Skill Absorb Damage Converts 7% of received damage to health. Unlocks once 2 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Hearten Doubles the duration of Inspire. Unlocks once 4 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Inspiration Cloak Decreases all received damage -100 for 3 seconds after receiving critical damage. This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered. Unlocks once 6 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Unassailable Grants a 1% chance to become immune to all damage for 2 seconds after receiving any damage. This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered. Unlocks once 7 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Improved Targeting Increases the Accuracy of all attack types +8%. Unlocks once 8 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Magic Condenser Increases all Critical Rates and Critical Heal Rate +6%. Unlocks once 9 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Teleportation Discipline Teleportation has a 50% chance to eliminate its cooldown and allow consecutive teleports. Mirror Warp has a 50% chance to sustain the buff and allow consecutive use. Unlocks once 10 skill points are spent in Auramancy. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Merciless Manipulator Comet's Boon, Spell Shield, Vicious Implosion, Shrug It Off, and Liberation each grant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used. Cannot be upgraded further. Inoch Followers of Auramancy look to Inoch, a pious priest who was turned into an Astra as a child and would later become Haje, the god of doors and seals. In his tradition an auramancer shields and strengthens the whole party and keeps its allies standing when the magic gets thick. Auramancy is a utility skill tree. It strengthens allies and weakens enemies with Inspired stacks, energy shields and magic immunity, and it brings teleports, cleanses and a buff steal. Its own damage is limited, so it is usually paired with trees that deal damage and heal. Inoch

Followers of Auramancy look to Inoch, a pious priest who was turned into an Astra as a child and would later become Haje, the god of doors and seals. In his tradition an auramancer shields and strengthens the whole party and keeps its allies standing when the magic gets thick.

Auramancy is a utility skill tree. It strengthens allies and weakens enemies with Inspired stacks, energy shields and magic immunity, and it brings teleports, cleanses and a buff steal. Its own damage is limited, so it is usually paired with trees that deal damage and heal.
